name: Tags
access: OML creates this object from a selector:Tags node. Reach the instance with find or cfind, then call methods on that instance. Method names are not OML keys.

properties.name: add
properties.description: The user can type to search or add tags. Optional.

properties.name: remove
properties.description: The user can remove tags. Optional.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Name of a hidden field that holds the value. Optional.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Required flag of that hidden field, when name is set. Optional.

properties.name: lowercase
properties.description: Saves the typed tag in lowercase. Optional.

properties.name: max
properties.description: Maximum tags the user can add. Optional.

properties.name: display_max
properties.description: Maximum suggestions to display. The wiki also describes this as adding a +N other tag. Optional.

properties.name: display_more
properties.description: Shows a +N other tag at the end of the list. Optional.

properties.name: click_more
properties.description: With display_more, a click shows every tag. Optional.

properties.name: hide_input_on_disable
properties.description: Hides the input when the component is disabled. Optional.

properties.name: tags_ascii
properties.description: Map of tags to ascii values. Optional.

properties.name: image
properties.description: URL of the remove icon. Optional.

properties.name: restrict
properties.description: true uses the default Form restriction. An object is a Form.restrictField config. Optional.

properties.name: strict
properties.description: The user can only pick a proposed tag. Defaults to false. Optional.

methods.name: val
methods.description: Gets or sets the user tags. val(array) sets them. val(property, value) sets them by lookup. val() returns them.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Gets or sets the autocomplete tags.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a user tag. The wiki comment on that line says Add.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Gets or sets the display of the internal lists.

events.name: OGX.Tags.ADDED
events.description: A user tag was added. The event string is TagsAdded. The wiki page writes TAG_ADDED, which is not the runtime constant.

events.name: OGX.Tags.REMOVED
events.description: A user tag was removed. The event string is TagsRemoved. The wiki page writes TAG_REMOVED, which is not the runtime constant.

events.name: OGX.Tags.CHANGE
events.description: A tag was added or removed. The event string is TagsChange. OGX.Tags.BIND is the same constant.

events.name: OGX.Tags.SELECT
events.description: The user touched a current tag. The event string is TagsSelect.

catalog_status: Listed fields and methods are from the OGX.JS wiki or the runtime the test app loads. Members that are absent from this file are not to be invented.
